#!/bin/sh
# Run the real clip lifecycle + panel with mocked USB and captured draw calls.
# Reuse the existing knob harness extraction; render metrics come from generated production fonts.
set -eu
cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.."
SRC=${SRC:-firmware/src}
OUT=${OUT:-build/host/clip_chord}
export SRC OUT
sh tests/host/smk_clip_knob_test.sh --extract-only
python3 tools/gen_font.py "$OUT/felucca_font.h"
python3 - "$SRC" "$OUT" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
src,out=map(pathlib.Path,sys.argv[1:])
s=(src/'app/main_fm1.c').read_text()
a=s.index('/* ------- clip mode screen:')
b=s.index('/* The stage settings',a)
(out/'chord_screen.inc').write_text(s[a:b])
g=(src/'gfx.c').read_text(); u=(src/'app/ui.c').read_text()
def fn(s,name):
 a=s.index(name); a=s.rfind('\n',0,a)+1; b=s.index('{',a); level=1; e=b+1
 while level:
  level += (s[e]=='{')-(s[e]=='}');e+=1
 return s[a:e]+'\n'
(out/'chord_metrics.inc').write_text(fn(g,'static uint32_t glyph(')+fn(g,'static int32_t text_w(')+
 'typedef struct { const felucca_font_t *f; int8_t top, bot; } capm_t;\nstatic capm_t capm[6];\n'+
 fn(u,'static const capm_t *caps(')+fn(u,'static int32_t vc('))
PY
# CK_RATE_T / ck_arp_pick live in smk_clip_arp_share.c (size share); same link as smk-clip-keys.
${CC:-cc} -std=gnu99 -O1 -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-function -Wno-unused-variable -Wno-unknown-attributes \
  -I"$SRC" -Ifirmware/hal -I"$OUT" -o "$OUT/smk_clip_chord_display_test" \
  tests/host/smk_clip_chord_display_test.c firmware/src/app/smk_clip_arp_share.c
"$OUT/smk_clip_chord_display_test"

#!/bin/sh
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
# tools/require_gate_pass.sh, check 6 (core rule 6A, install rule 6): the queue file QUEUE.md in the results folder.
# Each open line "- [ ] <commit> <text>" must name a commit that is the install commit or an ancestor of it.
# A temp repository: A, then B on A (the install commit, with a valid gate PASS), and C on A (not in B).
#   Each case sets X0X_QUEUE_FILE to a temp file (commit.md rule 9), so the live QUEUE.md never changes a result.
#   no queue file -> GATE OK (an install of a gated commit under the old rules still runs)
#   open A, open B, done C -> GATE OK.   open C -> REFUSED.   open unknown commit -> REFUSED.   open, no commit -> REFUSED.
#   fixtures/queue_guard/no-commit.txt (the form of the live QUEUE.md: open lines "- [ ] pending ..." with no commit)
#     -> REFUSED, exit 3 (Orchestrator 03:01: lock in this behaviour).
#   tools/sync_results_to_mac.sh copies QUEUE.md to the Mac copy, and the guard on the copy refuses open C.
set -u
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_OBJECT_DIRECTORY GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES GIT_COMMON_DIR GIT_PREFIX GIT_QUARANTINE_PATH GIT_NAMESPACE
unset X0X_GATE_LOGS_MAP X0X_SYNC_DIR X0X_QUEUE_FILE
G="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/../.." && pwd)/tools/require_gate_pass.sh"
SY="$(dirname "$G")/sync_results_to_mac.sh"
T=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/qguard.XXXXXX"); trap 'chmod -R u+w "$T" 2>/dev/null; rm -rf "$T"' EXIT
QF=$(mktemp "$T/queue.XXXXXX")   # commit.md rule 9: each case gives X0X_QUEUE_FILE = a temp file, never the live QUEUE.md
fails=0; n=0
expect() {  # expect <REFUSED|GATE OK> <name> [results folder] [queue file] [queue refusal reason]
    want=$1; name=$2; res=${3:-$T/res}; qf=${4:-$QF}; reason=${5:-}; n=$((n + 1))
    out=$(X0X_QUEUE_FILE="$qf" X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$res" X0X_REPO="$T/repo" bash "$G" "$B" 2>&1); rc=$?
    case "$want" in REFUSED) wrc=3;; *) wrc=0;; esac
    case "$out" in "$want "*)
        if [ "$rc" = "$wrc" ]; then
            case "$want:$out" in
                REFUSED:*)
                    # A provenance failure must not satisfy a queue refusal case.
                    case "$out" in *": open queue line"*"$reason"*) [ -n "$reason" ] && { echo "ok   $name: $out"; return; };; esac ;;
                *) echo "ok   $name: $(echo "$out" | tail -1)"; return ;;
            esac
        fi ;;
    esac
    echo "FAIL $name: rc=$rc out=$out"; fails=$((fails + 1))
}
gc() { git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -q "$@"; }
mkdir -p "$T/repo" "$T/res" && cd "$T/repo" && git init -q . && echo a > a.c && git add . && gc -m A && \
    A=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && echo b > b.c && git add . && gc -m B && B=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && \
    git checkout -q -b side "$A" && echo c > c.c && git add . && gc -m C && C=$(git rev-parse HEAD) && \
    cd - >/dev/null || { echo "FAIL setup"; exit 1; }
S=$(echo "$B" | cut -c1-7)
if command -v sha1sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then SHA1=sha1sum; else SHA1="shasum -a 1"; fi
TREE=$(git -C "$T/repo" ls-tree -r --full-tree "$B" | awk -F '\t' '$2 !~ /\.md$/' | $SHA1 | cut -c1-40)
T12=$(echo "$TREE" | cut -c1-12)
L="$T/work/$S.logs"; mkdir -p "$L"
printf 'gate: took the gate lock after 0 s\n' > "$L/gate.log"; printf 'ctl.img file crc32 00000000, 1 B\n' > "$L/crc.txt"
INPUT_ID=$(python3 - "$G" "$T/repo" "$B" "$L" <<'PYID'
import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(sys.argv[1]).parent))
import validation_inputs as v
# Synthetic provenance only for this disposable queue fixture; no validation run.
payload = {'schema': v.SCHEMA, 'mode': 'gate', 'source': v.source_tree(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3])}
data = {'schema': v.SCHEMA, 'inputs': payload, 'sha256': v.digest(v.encoded(payload))}
(Path(sys.argv[4])/'validation-inputs.json').write_text(json.dumps(data))
print(data['sha256'])
PYID
)
{ echo "# Gate result for tree $TREE"; echo; echo "Result: PASS"; echo; echo "- Commit: $B"
  echo "- Validation inputs: $INPUT_ID"
  echo "- Tree (SHA-1 of git ls-tree -r without *.md): $TREE"; echo "- Worktree: $T/work/$S. Logs: $L."
  echo; echo "## CRC manifest"; echo; cat "$L/crc.txt"; } > "$T/res/$TREE.md"
printf '| Commit | Tree | Git tree | Result | Result file | Time |\n|---|---|---|---|---|---|\n| %s | %s | 000000000000 | PASS | %s.md | 2026-10-17 02:00 +10 |\n' "$S" "$T12" "$TREE" > "$T/res/index.md"
queue() { { echo "# Queue"; echo; for l in "$@"; do echo "$l"; done; } > "$QF"; }
expect "GATE OK" "no queue file" "$T/res" "$T/absent-queue.md"
queue "- [ ] $A first change" "- [ ] $(echo "$B" | cut -c1-9) the install commit" "- [x] $C done, not in the set"
expect "GATE OK" "open lines in the history, done line outside"
queue "- [ ] $A first change" "- [ ] $(echo "$C" | cut -c1-7) a change that is not in the install commit"
expect REFUSED "open line not an ancestor" "$T/res" "$QF" "is not in the install commit"
queue "- [ ] 0123456789abcdef0123 a commit that is not in the repository"
expect REFUSED "open line with an unknown commit" "$T/res" "$QF" "is not in $T/repo"
queue "- [ ] a change with no commit"
expect REFUSED "open line with no commit" "$T/res" "$QF" "with no commit"
cp "$(dirname "$G")/../tests/host/fixtures/queue_guard/no-commit.txt" "$QF"
expect REFUSED "fixture no-commit.txt: open lines with no commit (exit 3)" "$T/res" "$QF" "with no commit"
# the Mac copy: --pack takes QUEUE.md, --unpack writes it, the guard reads it there
queue "- [ ] $C a change that is not in the install commit"; cp "$QF" "$T/res/QUEUE.md"; n=$((n + 1))
if X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/res" X0X_SYNC_DIR="$T/sync" bash "$SY" --pack >/dev/null 2>&1 && \
   X0X_RESULTS_DIR="$T/mac" bash "$SY" --unpack "$T/sync/latest.tar" >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -f "$T/mac/QUEUE.md" ]; then
    echo "ok   sync copies QUEUE.md"
else echo "FAIL sync does not copy QUEUE.md"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
expect REFUSED "guard on the Mac copy, open line not an ancestor" "$T/mac" "$T/mac/QUEUE.md" "is not in the install commit"
# commit.md rule 9: each test that runs require_gate_pass.sh sets X0X_QUEUE_FILE (bad fixture: fixtures/queue_guard/leaky_test.sh)
TD="$(dirname "$G")/../tests/host"
scanq() { for f in "$@"; do grep -qE 'bash +"?\$(G|Q)"? |require_gate_pass\.sh"? ' "$f" && grep -qE '(^|[^.])require_gate_pass\.sh' "$f" && ! grep -q 'X0X_QUEUE_FILE' "$f" && echo "$f"; done; }
n=$((n + 1)); r=$(scanq "$TD/fixtures/queue_guard/leaky_test.sh")
if [ -n "$r" ]; then echo "ok   scan flags the bad fixture leaky_test.sh"; else echo "FAIL scan does not flag fixtures/queue_guard/leaky_test.sh"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
n=$((n + 1)); r=$(for f in "$TD"/*.sh; do grep -qE 'bash +"?\$(G|Q)"? ' "$f" || continue; scanq "$f"; done)
if [ -z "$r" ]; then echo "ok   scan: each test that runs require_gate_pass.sh sets X0X_QUEUE_FILE"; else echo "FAIL scan: no X0X_QUEUE_FILE in: $r"; fails=$((fails + 1)); fi
echo "queue guard: $((n - fails)) of $n ok"
[ "$fails" = 0 ]

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""tools/add_ctl.py and web/fm1pkg.js insertCtl on an SMK-37 package (build/x0x-smk37.fwsc; skipped
without a build): the image lands in the Bluetooth block, every checksum is right again, nothing else
changes, --remove gives the package back byte for byte, Python and JavaScript give the same bytes,
and a damaged or unsuitable ctl.img is refused. Also fm1_install.py's explicit-controller guard."""
import argparse
import io
import json
import os
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import zlib
from pathlib import Path

SRC = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(SRC / "tools"))
import add_ctl  # noqa: E402
import fm1_install as fi  # noqa: E402
import fm1pkg_make as pm  # noqa: E402

fails = 0


def ok(cond, what):
    global fails
    if not cond:
        fails += 1
        print(f"FAIL {what}")


def make_ctl(size=40000, **over):
    h = dict(magic=0x43423058, ver=2, hsize=68, fw=0x20000, size=size, crc=0, abi=2,
             init=0x02087000 + 0xD8, poll=0x02087000 + 0xF0, slo=0x01C06E80, shi=0x01C07680,
             rlo=0x01C01800, rhi=0x01C07680, ilo=(1 << 29) | (1 << 31), ihi=(1 << 8) | (1 << 13))
    h.update(over)
    img = bytearray(size)
    for i in range(68, size):
        img[i] = (i * 13) & 0xFF
    struct.pack_into("<IHHIIIIIIIIIIII", img, 0, h["magic"], h["ver"], h["hsize"], h["fw"], h["size"], 0, h["abi"],
                     h["init"], h["poll"], h["slo"], h["shi"], h["rlo"], h["rhi"], h["ilo"], h["ihi"])
    struct.pack_into("<I", img, 16, zlib.crc32(img[:16] + b"\0" * 4 + img[20:h["size"]]) if not over.get("badcrc") else 1)
    return bytes(img)


def plain_area(logical):
    """the decrypted app area of a logical image, and its block size"""
    hdr = add_ctl._dec(logical[0:0x40])
    count = struct.unpack_from("<H", hdr, 8)[0]
    for i in range(count):
        e = add_ctl._dec(logical[0x40 + i * 0x50:0x40 + (i + 1) * 0x50])
        if struct.unpack_from("<H", e, 0)[0] == 0:
            break
    off, size = struct.unpack_from("<II", e, 8)
    flash = logical[off:off + size]
    isd = add_ctl._dec(flash[64:96])
    key = pm.chipkey_decode(bytes(flash[struct.unpack_from("<I", isd, 4)[0]:][:32]))
    head = bytearray(flash[0x4000:0x4020])
    pm.sfc(head, 0, 32, 0, key)
    blk = struct.unpack_from("<I", head, 8)[0]
    n = (blk + 31) & ~31
    area = bytearray(flash[0x4000:0x4000 + n])
    pm.sfc(area, 0, n, 0, key)
    return area, blk, flash


def main():
    pkg_path = Path(os.environ.get("X0X_SMK_PKG", SRC / "build" / "x0x-smk37.fwsc"))
    if not pkg_path.is_file():
        print("ble_pkg_test: skipped (no build/x0x-smk37.fwsc)")
        return 0
    raw = pkg_path.read_bytes()
    ctl = make_ctl()
    # the image checks
    ok(add_ctl.ctl_problem(ctl) is None, "a good image passes")
    ok(add_ctl.ctl_problem(ctl + b"\xff" * 44) is None, "erased controller tail is permitted")
    for suffix in (b"\x00", b"\x80", b"\xff\x00", b"\x00" * 44):
        ok(add_ctl.ctl_problem(ctl + suffix) is not None, "non-erased controller tail refused")
    for what, bad in (("CRC", make_ctl(badcrc=True)), ("ABI", make_ctl(abi=1)), ("init", make_ctl(init=0x02000000)),
                      ("RAM", make_ctl(rhi=0x01C08000)), ("TIMER5", make_ctl(ihi=1 << 31)), ("ALNK0", make_ctl(ilo=1 << 11)),
                      ("magic", b"\xFF" * 100), ("big", make_ctl(size=0x10001)), ("short", b"X0BC")):
        ok(add_ctl.ctl_problem(bad) is not None, f"refused: {what}")
    # in, and out again
    out = add_ctl.add(raw, ctl)
    ok(add_ctl.add(raw, ctl + b"\xff" * 44) == out, "erased padding does not change package bytes")
    try:
        add_ctl.add(raw, ctl + b"\x00")
        ok(False, "non-erased controller tail rejected before package write")
    except add_ctl.PkgError:
        pass
    ok(len(out) == len(raw), "same length")
    product, logical = add_ctl.logical_of(out)
    ok(product.startswith("SMK-37 "), "identity kept")
    ok(fi.package_damage(logical) is None, f"package CRCs: {fi.package_damage(logical)}")
    area, blk, flash = plain_area(logical)
    lo = 0x120 + add_ctl.CODE_MAX
    ok(area[lo:lo + len(ctl)] == ctl, "the image in the Bluetooth block")
    ok(area[lo + len(ctl):lo + 0x10000] == b"\xFF" * (0x10000 - len(ctl)), "the rest of the block erased")
    ok(struct.unpack_from("<H", area, 34)[0] == pm.crc16(area[0x120:0x120 + add_ctl.SMK_SLOT]), "app.bin CRC")
    ok(struct.unpack_from("<H", area, 32)[0] == pm.crc16(area[34:64]), "app.bin entry CRC")
    ok(struct.unpack_from("<H", area, 2)[0] == pm.crc16(area[32:blk]), "app area CRC")
    ok(struct.unpack_from("<H", area, 0)[0] == pm.crc16(area[2:32]), "app area head CRC")
    _, logical0 = add_ctl.logical_of(raw)
    area0, _, flash0 = plain_area(logical0)
    ok(area0[0x120:lo] == area[0x120:lo], "the app before the block unchanged")
    ok(area0[lo + 0x10000:] == area[lo + 0x10000:], "after the block unchanged (cfg_tool, the cfg)")
    ok(area0[64:0x120] == area[64:0x120], "the other entries unchanged")
    ok(flash0[:0x4000] == flash[:0x4000] and flash0[0x4000 + len(area):] == flash[0x4000 + len(area):],
       "flash outside the app area unchanged (the slot map too)")
    ok(add_ctl.add(out, None) == raw, "--remove gives the package back byte for byte")
    ok(add_ctl.add(raw, None) == raw, "an empty block on a package without one: no change")
    ok(add_ctl.add(add_ctl.add(out, make_ctl(60000)), ctl) == out, "replace, and back")
    try:
        add_ctl.add(raw, make_ctl(badcrc=True))
        ok(False, "a damaged image is refused")
    except add_ctl.PkgError:
        pass
    fm1 = SRC / "build" / "x0x.fwsc"
    if fm1.is_file():
        try:
            add_ctl.add(fm1.read_bytes(), ctl)
            ok(False, "an FM-1 package is refused")
        except add_ctl.PkgError:
            pass
    # a package with app code in the Bluetooth block (an X0X before 7054cc5, as 1.8-apc40): refused,
    # also --remove. The same package with the slot map record (the build limits the code since then): accepted.
    lo_blk = 0x120 + add_ctl.CODE_MAX
    st = add_ctl._open(logical0)
    st["area"][lo_blk:lo_blk + 38011] = bytes((i * 7 + 3) & 0xFF for i in range(38011))
    with_map = add_ctl._close(st)
    st = add_ctl._open(with_map)
    st["flash"][pm.SLOTMAP_OFF:pm.SLOTMAP_OFF + 16] = b"\xFF" * 16
    old_code = add_ctl._close(st)
    ok(pm.slotmap_of(old_code) is None and fi.package_damage(old_code) is None, "test package: no slot map, CRCs right")
    for what, c in (("ctl.img", ctl), ("--remove", None)):
        try:
            add_ctl.insert(old_code, c)
            ok(False, f"code in the Bluetooth block: {what} refused")
        except add_ctl.NoBlock as e:
            ok("Bluetooth block" in str(e), f"code in the Bluetooth block: {what} refused with a clear message")
    old_fwsc = add_ctl.fwsc_of(old_code, product)
    try:
        add_ctl.add(old_fwsc, ctl)
        ok(False, "add_ctl.add refuses an old package")
    except add_ctl.NoBlock:
        pass
    add_ctl.insert(with_map, ctl)            # code in the block but the slot map record: accepted (no raise)
    add_ctl.check_block(logical0)
    # the user's 1.8-apc40 package from the main tree, when it is there (X0X_OLD_PKG overrides the path)
    real_old = Path(__import__("os").environ.get("X0X_OLD_PKG", SRC.parent / "x0x37" / "build" / "x0x-smk37-elite-1.8-apc40.fwsc"))
    if real_old.is_file():
        try:
            add_ctl.add(real_old.read_bytes(), ctl)
            ok(False, f"{real_old.name} refused")
        except add_ctl.NoBlock:
            pass
    # JavaScript: the same bytes, the same verdicts
    node = shutil.which("node")
    if node:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
            td = Path(td)
            (td / "pkg.fwsc").write_bytes(raw)
            (td / "old.fwsc").write_bytes(old_fwsc)
            (td / "map.fwsc").write_bytes(add_ctl.fwsc_of(with_map, product))
            (td / "ctl.img").write_bytes(ctl)
            bads = {"crc": make_ctl(badcrc=True), "irq": make_ctl(ihi=1 << 31), "ram": make_ctl(rlo=0x01C00000),
                    "tail": ctl + b"\x00", "tail_after_erase": ctl + b"\xff\x00"}
            for k, v in bads.items():
                (td / f"bad_{k}.img").write_bytes(v)
            js = f"""
import {{ readFileSync, writeFileSync }} from "fs";
import {{ logicalImage, insertCtl, ctlProblem, CTL_NO_BLOCK }} from "{(SRC / 'web' / 'fm1pkg.js').as_posix()}";
const d = "{td.as_posix()}";
const pkg = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(d + "/pkg.fwsc")), ctl = new Uint8Array(readFileSync(d + "/ctl.img"));
writeFileSync(d + "/js_with.bin", insertCtl(logicalImage(pkg), ctl));
writeFileSync(d + "/js_without.bin", insertCtl(insertCtl(logicalImage(pkg), ctl), null));
const v = {{ good: ctlProblem(ctl) }};
for (const k of ["crc", "irq", "ram", "tail", "tail_after_erase"]) v[k] = ctlProblem(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(d + "/bad_" + k + ".img")));
for (const k of ["old", "map"]) {{
  try {{ writeFileSync(d + "/js_" + k + ".bin", insertCtl(logicalImage(new Uint8Array(readFileSync(d + "/" + k + ".fwsc"))), ctl)); v[k] = null; }}
  catch (e) {{ v[k] = e.message; }}
}}
v.noblock = CTL_NO_BLOCK;
writeFileSync(d + "/js.json", JSON.stringify(v));
"""
            (td / "t.mjs").write_text(js)
            r = subprocess.run([node, str(td / "t.mjs")], capture_output=True, text=True)
            ok(r.returncode == 0, f"node: {r.stderr.strip()}")
            if r.returncode == 0:
                ok((td / "js_with.bin").read_bytes() == add_ctl.insert(logical0, ctl), "JS insertCtl = Python insert")
                ok((td / "js_without.bin").read_bytes() == bytes(logical0), "JS remove = the original")
                v = json.loads((td / "js.json").read_text())
                ok(v["good"] is None and all(v[k] for k in ("crc", "irq", "ram", "tail", "tail_after_erase")), f"JS ctlProblem verdicts {v}")
                ok(v["old"] == v["noblock"] == add_ctl.NO_BLOCK, f"JS insertCtl refuses code in the block: {v['old']}")
                ok(v["map"] is None and (td / "js_map.bin").read_bytes() == add_ctl.insert(with_map, ctl),
                   "JS insertCtl with the slot map record = Python insert")
    else:
        print("ble_pkg_test: node not found, JavaScript parity skipped")
    # fm1_install.py: current SMK packages need an explicit or embedded controller.
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
        cache = Path(td) / "ctl.img"
        buf = io.StringIO()
        a = argparse.Namespace(ctl=None, no_ctl=False)
        cache.write_bytes(ctl)
        try:
            fi.with_ctl(a, "SMK-37 Pro_900", logical0, buf)
            ok(False, "empty SMK controller block is refused")
        except fi.InstallError as e:
            ok(e.code == "badpkg" and "empty" in str(e) and "--ctl" in str(e),
               "empty SMK controller block: clear refusal before device access")
        a.no_ctl = True
        try:
            fi.with_ctl(a, "SMK-37 Pro_900", logical0, buf)
            ok(False, "--no-ctl with an empty SMK controller block is refused")
        except fi.InstallError as e:
            ok(e.code == "badpkg" and "does not preserve" in str(e), "--no-ctl cannot erase the controller")
        class NoDeviceAccess:
            def input_names(self):
                raise AssertionError("controller guard reached the device")
        try:
            fi.run(argparse.Namespace(info=False, package=str(pkg_path), force=False, port=None, ctl=None,
                                      no_ctl=True, no_slots=False, backup=None, yes=True),
                   NoDeviceAccess(), io.StringIO(), lambda _p: True)
            ok(False, "empty SMK package run is refused")
        except fi.InstallError as e:
            ok(e.code == "badpkg" and "empty" in str(e), "empty --no-ctl run is refused before device access")
        a.no_ctl = False
        a.ctl = str(cache)
        ok(fi.with_ctl(a, "SMK-37 Pro_900", logical0, buf) == add_ctl.insert(logical0, ctl)
           and a.ctl_bytes == ctl, "explicit valid --ctl is added and selected for read-back")
        embedded = add_ctl.insert(logical0, ctl)
        b = argparse.Namespace(ctl=None, no_ctl=True)
        ok(fi.with_ctl(b, "SMK-37 Pro_900", embedded, buf) == embedded and b.ctl_bytes == ctl,
           "a valid embedded controller is preserved and selected for read-back")
        buf = io.StringIO()
        ok(fi.with_ctl(argparse.Namespace(ctl=None, no_ctl=True), "SMK-37 Elite_9010800", old_code, buf) == old_code
           and "not applicable" in buf.getvalue(),
           "an old package whose app owns the range remains installable without a controller")
        cache.write_bytes(ctl)
        try:
            fi.with_ctl(argparse.Namespace(ctl=str(cache), no_ctl=False), "SMK-37 Elite_9010800", old_code, buf)
            ok(False, "--ctl on an old package is refused")
        except fi.InstallError as e:
            ok(e.code == "badpkg" and "Bluetooth block" in str(e), "--ctl on an old package: badpkg, clear message")
        ok(fi.with_ctl(argparse.Namespace(ctl=None, no_ctl=False), "FM-1_900", b"x", buf) == b"x",
           "FM-1: the cache is not used")
        try:
            fi.with_ctl(argparse.Namespace(ctl=str(cache), no_ctl=False), "FM-1_900", b"x", buf)
            ok(False, "--ctl on an FM-1 package is refused")
        except fi.InstallError:
            pass
        (Path(td) / "bad.img").write_bytes(make_ctl(badcrc=True))
        try:
            fi.with_ctl(argparse.Namespace(ctl=str(Path(td) / "bad.img"), no_ctl=False), "SMK-37 Pro_900", logical0, buf)
            ok(False, "a damaged --ctl is refused")
        except fi.InstallError as e:
            ok(e.code == "badpkg", "badpkg")
    print(f"ble_pkg_test: {'ok' if not fails else str(fails) + ' failed'}")
    return 1 if fails else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Host-only OTA finish reply reliability test. No real device, MIDI, or flash.

    python3 tests/fm1_install_finish_ack_test.py
    python3 tests/fm1_install_finish_ack_test.py /path/to/extracted_source.py
"""
import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import unittest

source_path = (Path(sys.argv.pop(1)) if len(sys.argv) > 1
               else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'tools' / 'fm1_install.py')
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('x0x_install_ota_finish_under_test', source_path)
install = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(install)


class Link:
    def __init__(self, requests, *, reject=None, drop_when_empty=True):
        self.requests = list(requests)
        self.reject = set(reject or [])
        self.sent = []
        self.drop_when_empty = drop_when_empty

    @property
    def lost(self):
        return not self.requests and self.drop_when_empty

    def read(self, timeout):
        return self.requests.pop(0) if self.requests else None

    def send(self, packet):
        self.sent.append(packet)
        # The live MidoLink.send() returns False when MIDI send raises.
        # Source-matched extracted fixtures and the complete source both use
        # this interface; no real port is opened here.
        if isinstance(packet, tuple):
            addr = packet[0]
        else:
            # In complete-source mode, response() returns the MIDI/SysEx
            # packet. The marker is recorded from its data payload, not
            # otherwise changed or interpreted.
            addr = self.sent_addr.pop(0)
        return addr not in self.reject


class FinishAckTest(unittest.TestCase):
    @staticmethod
    def packet(addr, n=0, flags=0):
        return flags, addr, n

    def run_serve(self, requests, finish, reject=(), image=b'abcdef'):
        # Updater.serve reads parse_request() output. For the full module,
        # patch only the wire parser and response encoder: all decisions stay
        # in the actual source method. For the isolated fixture the same
        # interface is already provided; patching remains valid.
        from unittest import mock
        link = Link(requests, reject=reject)
        link.sent_addr = [v[1] for v in requests]
        # A response failure for one command must not be mistaken for success.
        with mock.patch.object(install, 'parse_request', side_effect=lambda p: p), \
             mock.patch.object(install, 'response', side_effect=lambda addr, buf, fl=0: (addr, bytes(buf), fl)), \
             mock.patch.object(install.time, 'sleep', return_value=None):
            events = []
            outcome = install.Updater.__new__(install.Updater).serve(link, image, finish,
                                                                    0.0, lambda *args: events.append(args))
        return outcome, link.sent, events

    def test_finish_check_reply_succeeds(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_CHECK)], install.FINISH_CHECK)
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, True, False))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_finish_check_reply_failure_is_connection_lost(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_CHECK)], install.FINISH_CHECK,
                                      reject=(install.FINISH_CHECK,))
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, False, True))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_finish_write_reply_succeeds(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_WRITE)], install.FINISH_WRITE)
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, True, False))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_finish_write_reply_failure_is_connection_lost(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_WRITE)], install.FINISH_WRITE,
                                      reject=(install.FINISH_WRITE,))
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, False, True))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_nonmatching_finish_reply_failure_is_terminal(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_CHECK), self.packet(install.FINISH_WRITE)],
                                      install.FINISH_WRITE, reject=(install.FINISH_CHECK,))
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, False, True))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_nonmatching_finish_reply_success_continues(self):
        got, sent, _ = self.run_serve([self.packet(install.FINISH_CHECK), self.packet(install.FINISH_WRITE)],
                                      install.FINISH_WRITE)
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, True, False))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 2)

    def test_bad_data_reply_failure_still_aborts(self):
        got, sent, events = self.run_serve([self.packet(0, 2)], install.FINISH_WRITE, reject=(0,))
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, False, True))
        self.assertFalse(events)
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 1)

    def test_successful_data_response_preserves_progress(self):
        got, sent, events = self.run_serve([self.packet(0, 2), self.packet(install.FINISH_WRITE)],
                                           install.FINISH_WRITE)
        self.assertEqual(got, (1, True, False))
        self.assertEqual(len(sent), 2)
        self.assertEqual(events, [(1, 2)])

    def test_empty_link_reports_disconnection_not_success(self):
        got, sent, events = self.run_serve([], install.FINISH_CHECK)
        self.assertEqual(got, (0, False, True))
        self.assertFalse(sent)
        self.assertFalse(events)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Synthetic, hardware-free tests for native package and controller integrity."""
from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path
import struct
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
import zlib

TOOLS = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2] / 'tools'
sys.path.insert(0, str(TOOLS))
import add_ctl
import fm1pkg_make as pkg
import check_native_build_output as guard


class OutputGuardTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.tmp.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.tmp.name)
        for name, data in {'uboot.boot': bytes(range(128)), 'cfg_tool.bin': b'CFG' * 60,
                           'cfg/eq_cfg_hw.bin': b'EQ' * 30}.items():
            path = self.root / 'cpu/wl82/tools' / name
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(data)
        pkg.set_board('smk37')
        pkg.SDK = self.root

    def package(self, model='elite'):
        content = pkg.ufw(pkg.flash_image(b'\xab' * 2048, pkg.KEY),
                          b'FAKE OTA PAYLOAD' * 15, guard.PRODUCTS[model])
        path = self.root / 'package.fwsc'
        path.write_bytes(content)
        return path

    def controller(self):
        buf = bytearray(128)
        struct.pack_into('<IHHIIIIIIIIIIII', buf, 0,
                         add_ctl.HDR_MAGIC, add_ctl.HDR_VERSION, add_ctl.HDR_SIZE,
                         1, len(buf), 0, add_ctl.ABI,
                         add_ctl.XIP + 80, add_ctl.XIP + 96,
                         add_ctl.RAM_LO + 16, add_ctl.RAM_LO + 256,
                         add_ctl.RAM_LO, add_ctl.RAM_LO + 512, 0, 0)
        crc = zlib.crc32(buf[:16] + b'\0' * 4 + buf[20:])
        struct.pack_into('<I', buf, 16, crc)
        path = self.root / 'synthetic-controller.img'
        path.write_bytes(buf)
        return path

    def test_both_matching_synthetic_models_accepted(self):
        for model in ('elite', 'pro'):
            with self.subTest(model=model):
                got = guard.check_firmware(self.package(model), model)
                self.assertEqual(got['model'], model)
                self.assertEqual(got['payloads'], ['flash.bin', 'ota.bin'])

    def test_wrong_model_fails(self):
        for model, other in [('elite', 'pro'), ('pro', 'elite')]:
            with self.subTest(model=model):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'wrong firmware model'):
                    guard.check_firmware(self.package(model), other)

    def test_corrupt_flash_or_loader_fails_crc(self):
        for segment in ('flash.bin', 'ota.bin'):
            with self.subTest(segment=segment):
                path = self.package()
                blob = bytearray(path.read_bytes())
                _, logical = add_ctl.logical_of(blob)
                hdr = bytearray(logical[:64]); pkg.enc(hdr, 0, len(hdr))
                count = struct.unpack_from('<H', hdr, 8)[0]
                listing = logical[64:64 + count * 80]
                index = 0 if segment == 'flash.bin' else 1
                entry = bytearray(listing[index * 80:(index + 1) * 80]); pkg.enc(entry, 0, 80)
                off, size = struct.unpack_from('<II', entry, 8)
                self.assertGreater(size, 0)
                # Converted from UFW logical offset to the fwsc inserted-marker offset.
                raw_off = off + (20 if off >= 20 * 47 else off // 47)
                blob[raw_off + 10] ^= 0x01
                path.write_bytes(blob)
                with self.assertRaisesRegex((ValueError, add_ctl.PkgError), 'CRC'):
                    guard.check_firmware(path, 'elite')

    def test_corrupt_and_truncated_package_refused(self):
        path = self.package()
        path.write_bytes(path.read_bytes()[:55])
        with self.assertRaises(add_ctl.PkgError):
            guard.check_firmware(path, 'elite')

    def test_synthetic_controller_crc_and_corruption(self):
        path = self.controller()
        guard.check_controller(path)
        invalid = bytearray(path.read_bytes())
        invalid[90] ^= 1
        path.write_bytes(invalid)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'CRC mismatch'):
            guard.check_controller(path)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)
